disclaimer: Swap suggestions are general guidance based on common physical therapy principles, not medical advice. Stop if pain increases and see a clinician.

reasons.note: Swap when no barbell or rack is available.
Swap when no bench or box is available.
Swap when no pull-up, dip or hanging bar is available.
Swap when no cable stack, machine, sled or cardio machine is available.
Limits deep or heavily loaded knee bending, kneeling and impact. Swaps to hip-driven work (hip thrusts, bridges, pull-throughs) and low-impact options. Stop if pain increases.
Limits deep hip bending, wide stances, rotation and impact. Swaps to supported and pain-free-range options. Stop if pain increases.
Limits loaded spine bending, heavy hinging, rotation and impact. Swaps to supported, seated and hip-driven options. Stop if pain increases.
Limits overhead reaching, deep pressing and hanging. Swaps to landmine, floor, neutral-grip and below-shoulder-height options. Stop if pain increases.

Almost every lift grips or presses, so these swaps lower elbow and wrist stress rather than remove it: neutral grips, cables and machines. Cut the weight 30 to 50 percent and use higher reps. Stop if pain increases.
Replaces jumping, running and landing with lower-impact options.
Gentler mobility options if a stretch or position is uncomfortable.
